title: Tech Note: Implementing a Remote Datastore
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The remote datastore feature (Open datastore, REST server exposure) introduced in 4D v18 is a foundational ORDA capability that is still current and central to how 4D applications interoperate with each other and with external clients today.
related_updates: ORDA remote datastores remain a core, actively maintained 4D feature used for 4D-to-4D and general REST-based integration
This is the modern replacement for older approaches like connecting via SQL server or the legacy 4D Open/ODBC style access between databases
